# Salo - Tahanan ng Pamilya

Salo is a private household feed and budget space for Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs) and their families. It bridges the distance by combining a private social feed with shared financial tracking—allowing families to transparently manage expenses, request "padala" (remittances), and stay connected in one secure space.

## Features
- **Private Household Feed**: Share updates, photos, and voice notes with your family.
- **Balikbayan Box Tracker**: Track the status of your Balikbayan boxes.
- **Shared Financial Tracking**: Transparently manage expenses and padala requests.
- **Invite-only Access**: Only family members with an invite code can join your household.

This application is primarily a private dashboard. You must be authenticated to access the feed.
